title: Populism
desc: Politics that sets 'the people' against a corrupt elite, and says the people's will should decide.
source: Global Party Survey 2019 (Norris), derived · 187 parties in 104 countries

title: Patronage politics
desc: Handing out jobs, projects and benefits mainly to your own supporters.
source: Global Party Survey 2019 (Norris), derived · 205 parties in 87 countries

title: Undermining democratic norms
desc: Weakening the courts, the press or the opposition in order to hold on to power.
source: Global Party Survey 2019 (Norris), derived · 112 parties in 77 countries

title: Conservatism
desc: Preserving established institutions and traditions, with change coming slowly.
source: Global Party Survey 2019 (Norris), derived · 42 parties in 28 countries

title: Social democracy
desc: A market economy with strong unions, a generous welfare state and public services.
source: Global Party Survey 2019 (Norris), derived · 41 parties in 31 countries

title: Liberalism
desc: Individual freedom and the rule of law, with limited government.
source: Global Party Survey 2019 (Norris), derived · 32 parties in 23 countries

title: Socialism
desc: Common ownership and a far bigger role for the state in the economy.
source: Global Party Survey 2019 (Norris), derived · 19 parties in 16 countries

title: Green politics
desc: Putting ecology first, alongside social justice and grassroots democracy.
source: Global Party Survey 2019 (Norris), derived · 14 parties in 14 countries

title: Christian democracy
desc: Politics built on Christian social teaching: family, community and moderate welfare.
source: Global Party Survey 2019 (Norris), derived · 14 parties in 12 countries

title: Radical right
desc: Nativist, nationalist politics that is hostile to immigration and the liberal establishment.
source: Global Party Survey 2019 (Norris), derived · 21 parties in 20 countries
